title: HE IS WORTHY
OF ALL PRAISE
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: sunlight filtering through ancient oak forest canopy
misty meadow at dawn with golden light
peaceful river flowing through a quiet valley
close up of dew on a vibrant green leaf
golden hour light over a rolling countryside
gentle stream reflecting the morning sky

scenes.a: If the weight of this decision keeps you awake tonight, simply rest your heart here.
You are invited to lift your eyes toward the majesty of the creator today.
Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honor and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
Father, we acknowledge that every breath we take is a gift from Your gracious hand.
Everything we see, and everything we hold dear, exists solely because of Your beautiful design.
May our hearts align with Your will, finding deep peace in Your perfect and sovereign care.
